text: APPROVE. The two try/catch blocks and the walkable-directory filter move into helpers with the same skip-on-error, push order and `testdata` exclusion, so behaviour is unchanged. The `is not { } x` patterns keep the variables definitely assigned, the CHA0004 pragma moves with the catch blocks, and removing the nested `if`/`&&` and two catches should bring the complexity below the threshold. I could not build or run the analyzer, and the `Where` call assumes `System.Linq` is already imported (e.g. via implicit usings).
